annotations.title: Silence an incident for a while

description: Pause the pager for one firing incident, for at most 240 minutes (4 hours; more is refused, not shortened). It drops to the quiet tier of the wall and sends nothing until it runs out or someone takes it off. A silence hides a problem from the people who would act on it: use it only for something you know is expected right now (a deploy, a drill, a host you are rebooting), say why in `reason`, and never to make a real problem go quiet. If you are working the incident, acknowledge it instead.

by.description: Who is doing this, as "agent: <who>", for example "agent: claude in web-app". Required: it is shown on the tile, in the incident sheet and in History. "agent: " is added when left off. At most 64 characters.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

minutes.description: How long, in whole minutes, from 1 to 240 (4 hours).

reason.description: Why it is expected or safe to pause this incident, at most 500 characters. Required: it is shown beside who silenced it.

name: silence
title: Silence an incident for a while
